hero.title: Dao Quang Thuan
hero.subtitle: Building reliable web platforms and AI-powered systems.
hero.description: I am a Software Engineer specializing in Backend architecture, asynchronous systems, and AI integration. I don't just write code; I focus on turning ideas into stable, cost-optimized products ready for real-world operations.

about.title: About Me
about.para1: My journey started with AI research and competitive programming training (OLP/ICPC), where I built a strong habit of reasoning under tight constraints. As I moved into Software Engineering, I positioned myself as a Product Engineer — responsible for the entire product lifecycle from architectural design to end-user experience.
about.para2: I am strongest when working on systems that need clear boundaries, resilient asynchronous processing, and smart trade-off decisions. I believe great software isn't just about running correctly; it must be observable, scalable, and highly optimized for operational resources.
about.skills_intro: Here are a few technologies and practices I have been working with recently:

points: Transitioned from AI research to contributing directly to the production codebase, taking ownership of complex backend modules using FastAPI, NestJS, and Message Queues.
Designed and implemented long-running task processing systems with robust retry mechanisms, exponential backoff, and real-time progress updates.
Proactively engaged in Product Discovery phases, proposing technical solutions that balance release speed with long-term stability and scalability.
Trained with the OLP/ICPC programming team, strengthening algorithmic thinking, problem decomposition, and debugging under time pressure.
Received the 'Excellent Research Project' recognition in the faculty-level student research competition.
Served as a teaching assistant for fundamental programming courses for four semesters, helping students build strong logical foundations.

featured.name: Enterprise AI Processing System (NDA)
visual_details: Designed the task submission UI and progress states for long-running work.
Accepted requests, validated input, and created job metadata for background processing.
Queued jobs for asynchronous workers so the main API stayed responsive.
Called AI services through an abstraction layer so providers can change safely.
Pushed processing status back to the frontend through a realtime channel.
desc: Implemented an asynchronous AI processing pipeline so long-running tasks are handled by background workers without blocking API responses.
Refactored provider selection with Factory Pattern, making the code easier to extend when adding or changing providers.
Fixed a production issue around queue message size limits by sending reference IDs instead of oversized payloads.
Built retry with exponential backoff and real-time progress through WebSockets so the system recovers better and users can follow processing status.

featured.name: AI Processing MVP (NDA)
visual_details: Built a web demo so stakeholders could test the processing flow early.
Designed backend endpoints and request flow for AI-driven processing.
Validated input format, limits, and edge cases before running processing steps.
Organized AI steps into a workflow that is easier to debug and improve.
Documented API contracts for client/mobile integration and testing.
desc: Joined technical brainstorming with the CEO and proposed three delivery options: fast MVP, AI-integrated version, and full-featured version.
Designed API endpoints for data processing, implemented backend logic, and wrote documentation for client/mobile integration.
Debugged post-release issues across input formats and browser environments.
Proposed a keep-alive direction for server sleep issues and improved validation so the demo became more stable during client testing.

featured.name: AI-Centric QR Menu Generator
visual_details: Built the digital menu interface and core user states in React.
Created admin-facing controls for content, configuration, and menu display flow.
Integrated QR payment for the MVP checkout scenario.
Sent order notifications through Telegram to simulate real operations.
Packaged, deployed, and iterated on the demo based on feedback.
desc: Built the QR Menu Generator MVP and deployed it for live testing at a local coffee shop.
Integrated a 2-way Telegram Bot notification system, allowing staff to confirm or cancel orders directly from the chat.
Optimized operational costs using Client-side Caching (IndexedDB), reducing Firestore read requests by 90% for repeat customers.
Implemented an automated VietQR payment flow, handling the entire order lifecycle from selection to payment confirmation.

list.name: CCCD/Passport Information Extraction
list.desc: Document information extraction mini project: YOLO detects data regions, VietOCR reads text, and a ReactJS + Flask web app presents the result.

list.name: Smart Home Website
list.desc: Web interface for smart home monitoring and device control, focused on responsive UI, state management, and a practical dashboard experience.

list.name: E-Commerce Fullstack Engine
list.desc: Self-built MERN Stack project for practicing fullstack workflows: product management, authentication, cart behavior, and end-to-end shopping flow.
